item.title: RhymeQ Secures $2.2 Million to Simplify Quantum Software Development
item.description: Insider Brief RhymeQ, a startup making quantum computers accessible to software developers across the world, has raised a $2.2 million pre-seed round led by Ground State Ventures, with participation from Vanagon Ventures, Plug and Play, and Freiraum Ventures. item.title: Plurilock Sets Vote on Quantum eMotion Acquisition
item.description: Insider Brief Plurilock Security shareholders will vote Nov. 18 on a proposed acquisition by Quantum eMotion, a deal intended to pair quantum-based security technology with an established cybersecurity business and its customer network.
